title: Synthetic EuroStable ART White Paper

delivery_block.review_gate: External filing, publication and notification are blocked until a qualified lawyer signs off and the deterministic CLI has been rerun against the remediated local draft.

editor_draft_package.review_gate: Suggested edits are local drafting aids and require lawyer review.

review_table_economics.reset_strategy: Each rule row and generated review column is evaluated from deterministic parser output and the local rule catalog.

control_profile.route_summary: Rule evaluation, coverage, remediation and review-table export are deterministic. No LLM route or external delivery route is present.
control_profile.context_window_strategy: 18 rule row(s), each evaluated against deterministic parser output and the local rule catalog.

source_connectors.label: Draft white paper
source_connectors.gate: Local file only. Source hash is included when a path is provided.

source_connectors.label: MiCAR rule catalog
source_connectors.gate: Rules are deterministic and versioned in source control.

source_connectors.label: Source anchors
source_connectors.gate: Citation and source anchor coverage must be checked by the reviewer.

source_connectors.label: Notification workflow
source_connectors.scope: BaFin or exchange-facing submission steps are outside the CLI.
source_connectors.gate: External filing requires separate lawyer approval.

workflow_routes.label: Rule evaluation
workflow_routes.gate: Automated pass does not equal legal sign-off.

workflow_routes.label: Remediation drafting
workflow_routes.gate: Blockers must be cured before notification or publication reliance.

workflow_routes.label: Review table export
workflow_routes.gate: Reviewer decisions remain pending in the exported table.

workflow_routes.label: External filing
workflow_routes.gate: No external filing or delivery route is implemented.

prompt_improvement.objective: Turn deterministic rule findings into reviewer-controlled remediation instructions.
prompt_improvement.jurisdiction: EU MiCAR white paper disclosure review
required_inputs: finding status, blocker flag and issues
source anchor and draft hash when available
prompt_improvement.review_gate: Draft remediation only. The linter never files, notifies or publishes.
failure_conditions: Do not invent facts or source anchors.
Do not mark a blocker cured before the deterministic linter is rerun.
Do not describe a notification, publication or exchange submission as approved.
prompt_improvement.suggested_prompt:
Role: MiCAR white paper reviewer.
Objective: remediate deterministic findings for Synthetic EuroStable ART White Paper.
White paper type: art.
Open blockers: COMMON.IXBRL_TAGGING, ANNEX_II.G.COMPOSITION_DISCLOSURE, ANNEX_II.G.DEPOSIT_FLOOR_REVIEW, ANNEX_II.G.CUSTODY.
Missing rules: COMMON.IXBRL_TAGGING.
Source anchors: 18/18 rule row(s).
Output: remediation by rule id, source anchor to verify, reviewer decision and filing gate.
Review gate: draft only. Rerun the deterministic CLI before relying on any cure.
